flow.noAccount: No bank account is set up for your profile, so there is nowhere to import to. One is created automatically at sign-up; if sign-up was interrupted, ask the app owner to add one.
flow.helpTitle: Where do I find this file?
flow.helpBody: Sign in to your bank's website and open your account's transactions. Look for an Export or Download option and choose CSV.
flow.helpBody2: Then come back here and choose that file. franC never contacts your bank.
